div.div: A chunk is not a pod resource. Upload to object storage before the rollout, keep the last few builds, and a retired pod takes nothing with it.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 378px; height: 1px; padding-top: 430px; margin-left: 417px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: var(--dg-ok-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-ok-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Detect the new build, offer a reload

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 378px; height: 1px; padding-top: 470px; margin-left: 418px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-muted);

display: inline-block; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-muted); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Poll a tiny /version.json; when the SHA changes show a toast. Never force a reload on someone mid-form.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 529px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-warn-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Pick the strategy from what a bad version costs, not from what is fashionable: rolling for a low-stakes internal app, blue-green when rollback speed is the requirement, canary when a regression must be found on 1% of users instead of all of them.
